problem_type: Existing custom text bridge contradicts selected identity and evidence
symptom: Selected Codex/Claude errors silently invoke another CLI; bridge forces English, drops images and reports fixed150tokens.
direct_cause: Catch-all provider fallback, blanket language rewriting, text extraction drops non-text parts, and hardcoded usage in JSON/SSE.
class_root: Existing custom bridge does not preserve request identity, modality, language or evidence at its shared admission/response boundaries.
affected_population: Existing custom CLI bridge HTTP requests
internal_only_reason: Repair of a user-provided customization using the existing Nomi generic OpenAI-compatible connection; official CLI/MCP architecture is unchanged. No external protocol extensions or new bridge engine.
invariants: Exact selected CLI is the only invoked provider; failure is explicit.
Non-text content is rejected before any CLI starts.
Conversation language and authoritative prompt text are preserved.
Missing measured usage stays unknown; never fabricate token counts.
Do not write future raw prompts or replies to disk.
Pre-aborted requests start no CLI; cancellation settles every selected runner without substituting another provider.
Only non-null JSON request objects reach field projection; scalar/array bodies return400 before any CLI starts.
All CLI cancellation/timeout tree termination uses the existing checked script process owner; failed cleanup is an error.

door_reduction.why_not: Standalone script internal request/prompt/runner/response doors remain necessary; cross-provider fallback branches are removed inside these shared owners. Door-map explicitly scans scripts; it does not confuse a private extractor with unrelated src/electron extractText symbols.

generality_proof: Enforce on common request projection and exact dispatcher, with shared JSON/SSE response behavior. All existing routes/aliases use these boundaries.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Exact request identity and no provider substitution.
Preserve authoritative language and reject unsupported content.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: VM handler test with local reply fixture asserts no fabricated usage.
VM handler SSE test asserts no fabricated usage.

recurrence.reason: Same fallback and fabricated evidence spans all selected CLIs and both response formats.
same_class_scan: Read entire preserved Desktop bridge including prompt construction,3CLI runners,exact dispatch,GETmodels and both completion branches.
Compared official native Antigravity Windows fail-closed policy and generic OpenAI model-list descriptor owner.
Independent source review found null body access outside the request try/catch; five actual handler body-shape regressions and all three shared-owner cancellation routes checked.

prevention.invariant: Exact provider/language/text-only admission and truthful optional usage apply to every retained request path.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported content or unknown model rejects before invocation; selected CLI failure remains failure; missing usage omitted.
prevention.strategy: Remove fallback and blanket English rewriting; retain existing request/response transport.

legacy_paths.rationale: Existing script fallback,forced English,fake usage and future raw logging branches removed in same change; no parallel implementation.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No CLI/SDK version change or inference; existing native support claims retained only as actual repo contract.

migration: Original Desktop dirty source and raw logs preserved. Active service remains unchanged until validated activation task. Existing bridge remains explicitly a customization.
residual_risks: Actual CLI authentication/inference excluded; local test doubles do not prove live provider readiness.
Native Antigravity on Windows remains officially unsupported; existing custom bridge route is not proof of native support.
